killedBy: the retarget REASON is recorded, not just returned (issue #359) records TARGET-LOST when the committed opponent dies, and resets the age
why: Writes the new reason but leaves the age running, so a switch that happened this tick reports the age of the PREVIOUS one. The reason would still be right and the label would still show a glyph -- it is only the staleness cutoff downstream that goes wrong, hiding a fresh switch or showing a stale one. A test asserting only that the reason changed passes on this.
